column1: Combine the milk, milk powder, and glucose in a pot. Heat while stirring until the mixture comes to a boil, taking care not to scorch the milk.
In a separate heatproof bowl, thoroughly mix the sugar and stabilizer so the stabilizer is evenly dispersed.

Gradually pour the hot milk mixture into the sugar and stabilizer while whisking until smooth and dissolved. Follow the stabilizer manufacturer's instructions for any required activation temperature or holding time.
Add the double cream and blend until the mixture is smooth and fully combined.
Cool promptly in an ice bath, then refrigerate until thoroughly cold and at the starting temperature required by your gelato machine.
Churn according to the machine's instructions. Divide the mixture into batches if needed to stay within the machine's maximum fill level.
